info.name: Sprachweg API smoke tests
info.description:
Smoke suite for the Sprachweg backend (run against the `dev` profile with seeded demo data).

`npx newman run backend/postman/sprachweg.postman_collection.json -e backend/postman/sprachweg.postman_environment.json --env-var baseUrl=http://localhost:8080`

Requests are read-only apart from logging in; folders depend on each other (tokens and ids are stored as collection variables), so run the collection in order.

exec: pm.test('seeded A1 course is listed', () => pm.expect(a1, 'course ' + pm.collectionVariables.get('courseSlug')).to.be.an('object'));
pm.test('draft course is not listed', () => pm.expect(page.content.map((c) => c.slug)).to.not.include('pruefungsvorbereitung-goethe-b2'));
pm.test('size clamped to 100, page to 0', () => { pm.expect(page.size).to.eql(100); pm.expect(page.page).to.eql(0); });
pm.test('outline lists live modules with items', () => {
pm.test('public outline does not expose item bodies', () => course.outline.flatMap((m) => m.items).forEach((i) => pm.expect(i).to.not.have.property('body')));
